First of all, I thank Mother Mary and Jesus countless times for allowing me to stand here at this altar and give my testimony.
My name is Baby, I come from a place called Kumbalam.
This is my husband, and this is my elder son. I came here for the first time on December 17, 2022.
The reason I came here was because there was a big debt in my house. Before I came here—
The first time I came and the situation that led me to come was that I saw a prayer service from here on YouTube. I joined that prayer service, and—
After that, I saw many covenant testimonies. Then I felt, if I come near my Mother Mary—
She will also fulfill my matters, and Mother will save us. With that firm faith, every day—
Every day I started to watch one covenant testimony. I thought, if I come quickly to the presence of Mother—
I and my family will be saved. With that firm faith, I greatly desired to come. Three months—
Passed like that, as I continued to watch all the testimonies and join the prayer services. Even before coming here—
I used to do all that. Then one day, crying, I told my husband, I want to go to Kreupasanam Church.
I said, if we go there, we will be saved. Then he told me, there is a church nearby here, right?
If you go there and pray, won’t that be enough? I am a Hindu. You go there every week, don’t you?
Then why do you need to go all the way to Kreupasanam in Alappuzha? He asked me that.
I said, I want to go there. I see many testimonies, I join the prayers. So if we go there, Mother will not abandon us.
I told him that. He did not have any strong faith. Still, moved by my crying—
He told me, I will take you there. That’s how we first came here, me and my husband together.
When we reached here, it was very crowded. I said, whatever happens, I want to take the covenant.
Since he is a person without much patience, he told me, if you take the covenant, it will take a lot of time.
Let’s just pray and go. Even if you don’t take the covenant, Mother will listen. That’s what he told me.
But I was not willing. I said, if you want to go, you go. I will come alone. Whatever happens, I will only return after taking the covenant.
That’s how I first came here, took the covenant, offered my intentions, and went back.
Every month, I used to come here. Like that, after three months passed, suddenly one day—
I had stomach pain. Then I went to see the doctor. After that, they told me I need surgery for hernia.
That surgery was done. While I was waiting for the surgery, about our debt—
For my husband’s younger sister’s marriage expenses, we had taken a loan from the bank. We could not repay it, and the threat of confiscation came.
The bank people came home and gave a confiscation notice. At that time, I was preparing for surgery.
I had no way out. I came here with that confiscation notice and met Respected Father Joseph.
Father prayed here and gave me a small covenant medal, telling me to sprinkle salt at home and bury it.
I did that. After that, I came to Mother and said, Mother, tomorrow is my surgery. I am going for surgery.
I prayed, Mother, when I return after surgery, there should be a place for me to stay without the bank people coming for confiscation.
I entrusted that into Mother’s hands and left. When I return, I must have a place to stay.
I do not have another house of my own. My family is living in a rented house. So I cried here and told Mother not to abandon me, and that is how I went to the hospital.
Until the time I went to the hospital, until I entered for surgery—
I had the covenant medal in my hand. Holding it tightly, my problem at that time was not my surgery—
But my confiscation notice. As I was going into the operation theater—
They told me, no medal or anything should be taken inside.
So I gave the covenant medal and the rosary to my husband’s younger sister, and then I went. My surgery was at six in the morning.
I was brought out only around eight-thirty at night. For two days, because of pain—
And because my memory was not proper, I could not get up or pray.
On the third day, at five in the morning, when I woke up, I wanted to recite the Rosary.
I learned to recite the Rosary only through YouTube. Since I am Hindu, I did not know any of this.
I wanted to recite the Rosary, and I also felt like I should read the Bible. When I came here, I had brought money to buy a Bible—
But it was not available here because the Bibles were finished. So I told one of my friends—
She was Christian, and she bought me a Bible. That is how I started reading the Bible without stopping.
At that time, the covenant medal I had given to my sister before going for surgery somehow got lost from her hand.
That was a great sorrow for me. After three months, when my surgery and rest were finished, I again came here.
I came to renew my covenant. When I spoke here, they told me the covenant medal will not be given again. If you want, you must take a new covenant.
I wanted my covenant medal, because that was my strength and my power. For me, Mother was with me in that.
So I said, I want the covenant medal. But they said it cannot be given like that.
I insisted, but still they did not give. So again, I took a new covenant. Again I took another new covenant. Now I am renewing for the fourth time.
But even after taking new covenants, my issue was not solved. The bank officer again came with the confiscation notice.
So again I ran here and told Mother, I have no way before me.
Mother, do not let us be thrown into that big road. If we are thrown out, there is no way left but suicide.
The only end for the four of us will be death, I cried and said.
Meanwhile, my husband went around all our relatives’ and acquaintances’ houses begging. But no one helped us.
Only God was there for us.
In that distress, I again came here. I prayed, Mother, now I can do nothing more.
Mother, if I have any faults or sins, I do not know. I am a Hindu. Is it because of my shortcomings that my intentions—
Alone are not being fulfilled? With tears, I prayed here and left.
Then I remembered what respected Father Joseph had once said: sometimes we write our intentions and leave them here,
and many like me do the same. We should not pray only for our own matters.
I understood that. I realized I must have my own shortcomings. Maybe because of my shortcomings, this covenant intention was not being fulfilled.
At that time, I placed an intention for my elder son, who had just finished his ITI course, to get a job, and that was fulfilled.
I said my children wanted a vehicle. But with the bank seizure notice pending, how could I buy a bike for them?
I came here and shared my sorrow with Mother: “Mother, I do not have the means to buy a bike. Please help me.
Even a second-hand bike for my children, Mother, please provide it.” I prayed and then went back.
To place the bike, I bought a keychain with Mother’s picture on it and brought it here.
I told Mother: “Mother, this is all I am able to give now. You must provide the bike.” I said that and went back home.
When I gave the keychain at home, my children teased me: “Mother, why did you buy a chain without buying the bike?”
I laugh now thinking about it, but that day I had cried a lot. I told them: “Mother will give. I have entrusted it to Mother.”
Within a month, Mother blessed us and provided a new bike.
The next day. I brought the key here, showed it to Mother, and gave thanks.
I told Mother: “I could not bring the bike here, but I can at least show you the key.” I showed it and went back.
That is how this testimony happened. When I came here the second time to renew the covenant,
I prayed to Jesus: “Jesus, I am a Hindu. I have many shortcomings. I do not know much.
Whatever I do, I do it in Your name. Only small things I can do. May You accept them with joy.”
Saying this, I did everything. I came here the second time to renew the covenant. After renewal,
they told us to stand in line to receive the token. I too went and stood there. I wasn’t paying attention to what the Sister was saying. From there I was talking to my Mother.
I said, “Mother, even if my biggest desire, the intention, if not fulfilled, it is not a problem. May You anoint me so that I can stand with You and Jesus.”
I prayed like that. One of my greatest dreams is to carry Mother in my hands and perform that dedication. Mother,
Let my desire be fulfilled. I am not saying that it has to be right now.
If I am worthy to carry Mother in my hands, make me worthy for that, that alone is enough.
Saying this, I was speaking, and meanwhile they were giving out the tokens there. I did not notice that at all.
While I was standing there speaking to Mother, I felt as if Mother looked at my face and smiled.
Suddenly, from behind, someone tapped me twice on my shoulder. When I turned and looked,
a Sister here placed a token in my hand. I never looked at the token. I looked at the Sister.
The Sister looked at me, smiled, and walked away. Then they said, “Everyone, pray and look at the token you have received in your hands.”
As soon as I looked at the token, I was shocked. What I had received was Mother.
I had never experienced such joy before. In that very second, Mother blessed me with the fortune of taking her in my hands.
It was something more precious to me than all my intentions, something unforgettable in my life.
Even now, when I say this, I feel a chill through my body.
At that moment, I experienced a strange coldness and trembling. I broke down crying there.
Everyone standing to my left, right, front, and back was looking at me. They did not know why I was crying.
The reason I cried was the love and joy I felt toward Mother.
In that very second, my desire was fulfilled by my Mother. Out of that happiness, I broke down crying.
That is how I completed that covenant renewal and went back.
When I went home, I again said, “Mother, I received so much joy. But still, my matter regarding the attachment case is pending.
Whenever it is possible for You to give, let it be given in Jesus’ and Mother’s time.” Saying that, I went back.
That’s how it was. For the sake of business, I spoke to my husband about a property that was not ours.
Through an intermediary, we decided to stop them. As we proceeded with that, they said we needed a paper from about 50 years ago.
Because of that, they said it will not happen. Then I again ran here and said, “Mother, if this is done through my husband as the intermediary, then Mother, I will come here and testify.”
We have no way. I firmly believe that this is given by Mother.
I said, “It is Mother herself who has brought this to clear our debts,” prayed, and went home.
I told my husband, “You must come with me to pray. You must listen when I say. So let us take this covenant salt there and pray. After that, if our matter is done, we must come here and testify.”
He agreed. At night we went, stood there, prayed, recited the profession of faith, and prayed with the salt.
As a result of that prayer, the place which had been refused was again returned, and they took that place.
They sold that place, and through that, six lakhs and a 75 thousand rupees came to my husband.
On June 18th we received the cheque. On that same day we went to the bank, spoke with them, and they said it would take three days for us to get it in cash.
On the next day, 19th morning, I had already told Mother one thing: “Mother, if this is to happen, let it be revealed before my Mother and Jesus even before anyone else knows. I will not tell this to anyone.”
On the morning of the 19th, we got into the vehicle and came here. I and my husband came, and before Mother and Jesus I said, “Many thanks.”
This Sister was here. I went to the Sister and said, “It is the bank’s attachment proceedings,” and I explained everything.
She asked, “Was the cash paid?” I said, “No, they said three days’ time is needed.”
She said, “After paying the money and clearing the attachment, you can testify,” and we went back.
As I was leaving from here, I said to Mother, “Mother, seven lakhs sixty-six thousand three hundred rupees is the amount we must pay.
What we got is six lakhs and a 75 thousand rupees. From that, the balance amount still must be made up.”
“Before me there is no way. Meanwhile, the gold that was pledged has also been placed for auction.”
The bank officers’ calls cannot be stopped, there is no peace, no calm, only crying, and no one has food.
We are going through such situations. Then, with the six lakhs and a 75 thousand  rupees received, from here I said to Mother,
“Mother, I still have more amount to pay from this. What will I do now? There are no ways before me. Only Mother and Jesus are there.”
“So Mother, do one thing for me. Mother who has done this much, deliver me from this also. I fully believe this.”
“Mother, reduce it and make it five lakhs rupees for me.”
From here I said, “I will not go to my house, I am going to the bank. My husband with my son will go to the bank and talk. Mother, You must reach there before us.”
We went with the covenant medal to the bank and spoke there.
They said they would reduce the amount a little, to five lakhs 15 thousand rupees. So from there, we returned peacefully.
Anyway, my husband was satisfied, saying, “Didn’t they say five lakhs 15 thousand rupees, five thousand reduced.”
I said, “No, what I asked my Mother is five lakhs rupees. My Mother will reduce it to that. I strongly believe it.”
I believe it was my Mother who saved me in that itself, saying that the cash could be paid after three days.
She said so, and we returned. On the third day, we went to the bank to pay the cash.
When we went to the bank, amazingly, we didn’t have to say anything there.
The bank manager told us, “Your matter has been informed here from above.
So, for you, five lakh rupees have been reduced,” he said. I felt like jumping from there.
There was no one to help us—no own people, no relatives, no villagers, no one at all.
It was my Mother and my Jesus who protected us.
If today in this Altar I, my husband, and children are standing, it is only by the blessing of my Mother and Jesus.
Until my death, I am indebted to Jesus and to my Mother.
And every dawn and evening when I pray, what I tell Jesus and Mother is this: “Mother, please anoint me and my family to remain joined with Jesus and you until my death.”
I also had spiritual matters. Long ago, whenever I prayed, there would be many like me here.
It was my sorrows that I first kept telling Jesus. But when this,
my greatest petition, did not happen, I felt there were some shortcomings in me. I realized that.
Many of the things Reverend Father Joseph said came back to my memory. I changed my prayer.
I did not pray for myself anymore. Instead, I began to pray for all the sick.
I prayed for those without homes, offering them in prayer. I prayed for childless couples, offering them in prayer.
I prayed for all those facing seizure actions, offering them in prayer. I prayed for all those living in rented houses, offering them in prayer.
In that way, one by one, I prayed for each—little children, alcoholics, everyone—offering them in prayer.
I began to pray to Jesus and Mother. My brothers, what I am saying is the truth:
never should we pray only for our own matters. When we begin to pray for others,
surely Jesus and Mother will never abandon us. I firmly believe this.
I tell you the same. From now on, everyone will be included in my prayers.
Likewise, I ask that in each of your prayers, you also include me and my family.
To my Jesus and Mother, who gave me so many blessings, I give countless thanks.
If Mother and Jesus had not been there, I would not have come to this holy ground. By this time, by June 30th, four deaths would have happened in our house.
If Mother and Jesus had not been there, I would not have come to this holy ground. By this June 30, four deaths…
I said, I am not afraid to commit suicide — I can just mix poison in the food and die.
That is what I had told my husband. But today it is my Mother and my Lord Jesus who have made me stand here at this altar.
Then, as works of mercy, I used to go to hospitals, especially government hospitals.
Even though my intentions were not fulfilled, I still used to go — giving food packets and going to the cancer center.
I went there to see the mothers, and gave whatever little financial help I could.
I also went to orphanages, and there too I gave whatever help I could — whether financially or by buying food items.
Still, I did everything I could. For giving me so many blessings, I give countless thanks to my Lord Jesus and to my Mother.
I still have many more matters. For those too, I know my Mother will accomplish them for me.
With the firm conviction that my Lord and my Mother will bring me again to this altar with even more strength and energy to give testimony, I stop here.
Endless thanks to my Mother and to Jesus. For removing this bank attachment, which I could not overcome,
